Directional Shadow

On hover/focus the shadow grows toward the bottom-right corner, as if lit from the upper-left.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.directional-shadow img{
  transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.hover-effect.directional-shadow:hover img,
.hover-effect.directional-shadow:focus-visible img{
  box-shadow:
    16px 16px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35),
    24px 24px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

The animates its box-shadow from a small centered shadow to a two-layer bottom-right offset shadow on hover/focus, creating a directional long-shadow. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.

Pure CSS Image Hover Effects · No JavaScript · MIT
